name: Virginia Open Spring 2016

venue.name: [Ern Commons](http://www.virginia.edu/deanofstudents/eventplanning/ern-commons/)
venue.details: Ern Commons is the building located between the Balz-Dobie and Watson-Webb dorms.

information:
This competition is free for all spectators, as well as competitors who are University of Virginia students, faculty, or staff.
The registration fee for competitors is a flat fee of $15 for all competitors. For your registration to be considered complete and for your name to appear on the competitors list, the payment must be paid via PayPal. This competition is only open to the first 100 competitors. Registration will close either when the number of registered competitors hits 100 or on March 30 at 11:59PM. No new registrations will be accepted on the day of the competition.
